answer: Vouches decay per epoch and stay in escrow until the epoch is final, so a reorg cannot resurrect a spent edge. No identity may audit its own recruit; each vouch names the task it covers, so the thread stays tied to work and a vouch naming no task is dropped at the forge. Edge case: two identities vouching for each other at the same block height are both frozen. That closes the bridge, at the cost of one epoch of delay for honest pairs.
